build_pixel_decoder: build a MSDeformAttnPixelDecoder instance with custom in_channels, strides, and feat_channels for multi-scale feature decoding
create_encoder_config: create a transformer encoder config dict with self_attn_cfg and num_levels for the pixel decoder
run_forward_pass: run the pixel decoder forward pass on a list of multi-scale feature tensors to get mask features
init_decoder_weights: initialize the pixel decoder weights using xavier, caffe2_xavier, and normal init strategies
review_forward_method: review the MSDeformAttnPixelDecoder forward method to understand multi-scale deformable attention and FPN-like upsampling
